game_title: Safe Get Scout – Frozen Waterfall Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Frost Peaks – Frozen Waterfall, a frozen waterfall: the rescue climber must handle frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Safe Get Scout: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors.
theme: Frost Peaks – Frozen Waterfall: a frozen waterfall
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Waterfall, repeat each round: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the safe_lookups value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about safe_lookups to power up the rescue climber and open the radio mast.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 4 (applied tier): Safe Get Scout
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how safe_lookups changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost wyrms in Frozen Waterfall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
